📖 How to use

  1. Choose your tea type from the dropdown.
  2. Check the recommended water temperature and notes.
  3. Press Start steeping and wait for the beep.
  4. Remove the leaves or bag and enjoy.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What steep times does it use?

Green 2 min at 80°C, white 4 min at 75°C, oolong 3 min at 90°C, black 4 min at 100°C, herbal 6 min at 100°C.

Why not use boiling water for all teas?

Boiling water scorches delicate green and white teas, making them bitter. Let boiled water sit a minute or two to cool to the right temperature.

Can I use it for multiple infusions?

Yes — restart the timer for each infusion and add ~30 seconds for every additional steep.
